_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a leading provider of video, high-speed Internet and phone services (“cable services”) to residential and business customers in the United States' (FY2010 10-K); 'On January 28, 2011, we closed our transaction with General Electric Company (“GE”) in which we acquired control of the businesses of NBC Universal'; 'Competition for the cable services we offer primarily includes direct broadcast satellite (“DBS”) operators and phone companies'; competitors include 'online services that offer Internet video streaming and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'

classification.quality_note: 'We are a leading provider of video, high-speed Internet and phone services (“cable services”) to residential and business customers in the United States' (FY2010 10-K); 'On January 28, 2011, we closed our transaction with General Electric Company (“GE”) in which we acquired control of the businesses of NBC Universal'; 'Competition for the cable services we offer primarily includes direct broadcast satellite (“DBS”) operators and phone companies'; competitors include 'online services that offer Internet video streaming and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.07x; +21% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.26; conservative 2yr +225%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +57.5%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.1-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +57.5%/yr (FY04-FY11 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +72.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY11); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2012-02-16) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.07x (40.7% downside to Bear $17 / +549.2% upside to Bull $186) | Adj composite 2.26 vs market 1.00: gap +1.26 [UNDERVALUED] | +21% above the EPP floor $24 (15x FY12E $1.58) | Conservative 2-yr case: +224.8% total (+112.4%/yr) | At 18.1x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $38 sits at or below the BASE case; video subscribers -2.0% in Q4 2011, forward revenues +54.7% (no FY12 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2011 revenue growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
